reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm survives the evidence tests. The strongest apparent family, P1–P14, fails the opaque index test: the numerals do not contribute literal count meaning but select different stored procedures, so these are whole lexemes, not P + NUMBER. The candidate /Bt face family is only a list of standalone face labels and does not provide segmented multi-morpheme codes with substitution in a shared frame. BR-T suggests a possible BR + FACE analysis, but there is no contrasting set like BR-Fr / BR-Bk / BR-Lf etc. actually attested in the same construction, so one split would be speculative. COLD and CLD do not support a shared cold morpheme either, because the residues C/CO lack stable, compositional meanings in the same frame. More broadly, many symbols are semantically related, but the codebook does not supply enough exact substitutional minimal pairs with predictable whole meanings to justify segmentation. Therefore the safest complete partition is a flat lexicon.
